content.text: Lots of kids are still co-sleeping around five, and it's very fixable. Start by making his own bed the place he falls asleep, with you still in the room. Do your usual bedtime routine, then sit on a chair beside his bed until he's asleep. Tonight, tell him plainly that this is the new plan and that you'll be right there. Every few nights, move the chair a bit closer to the door.
